title: Infini Memory: Maintainable Topic Documents for Long-Term LLM Agent Memory
title_zh: Infini Memory：面向长期 LLM Agent 记忆的可维护主题文档
abstract_en: Long-term LLM agents need persistent memory that can track changing facts and provide relevant evidence across sessions. Existing memory systems often store observations as isolated records, summaries, or indexed fragments, which makes evidence aggregation, fact revision, and memory maintenance difficult. We propose Infini Memory, a maintainable text-based persistent memory architecture that treats agent memory as topic-structured documents. Each topic document serves as a semantic unit for collecting related evidence, preserving metadata, and revising facts over time. New observations are first staged in a buffer and periodically consolidated into coherent textual contexts. At inference time, an agentic retrieval procedure lets the LLM read memory through iterative tool calls rather than a single retrieval step. On MemoryAgentBench, Infini Memory achieves 64.7% overall score. Ablations show that topic-structured maintenance and iterative evidence inspection improve complementary aspects of long-term memory use.
abstract_zh: 长期 LLM Agent 需要一种持久记忆机制，能够跨会话追踪不断变化的事实，并提供相关证据。现有记忆系统通常将观察结果存为孤立记录、摘要或索引片段，导致证据聚合、事实修订和记忆维护较为困难。本文提出 Infini Memory，一种可维护的文本化持久记忆架构，将 Agent 记忆组织为按主题划分的文档。每个 topic document 作为语义单元，用于收集相关证据、保留元数据，并随时间修订事实。新观察首先进入缓冲区，随后周期性整合为连贯的文本上下文。在推理阶段，系统采用 agentic retrieval 流程，使 LLM 通过迭代工具调用读取记忆，而非依赖单次检索。在 MemoryAgentBench 上，Infini Memory 取得 64.7% 的总体得分。消融实验表明，主题结构化维护与迭代证据检查分别提升了长期记忆使用中的互补能力。
key_points_zh: 提出 Infini Memory，将长期记忆组织为 topic-structured documents，而不是孤立记录、摘要或碎片索引。
每个主题文档聚合相关证据、保留元数据，并支持随时间进行事实修订，增强记忆的可维护性。
新观察先写入 buffer，再周期性整合为连贯文本上下文，降低即时写入带来的噪声与碎片化。
推理时采用 agentic retrieval，让 LLM 通过多轮工具调用迭代检查证据，而非单次检索返回结果。
在 MemoryAgentBench 上达到 64.7% overall score；消融显示主题维护与迭代证据检查带来互补收益。

llm_assessment.comment: A practical long-term memory architecture for agents with maintainable topic documents and iterative retrieval, though closed-loop evolution and governance are limited.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该工作提出了实用的长期记忆架构，使用可维护主题文档和迭代检索，但闭环演化与治理能力相对有限。
